items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1958-07-00
items.q: the same number that I wrote Dick

ctx.x: Oh yeah man. You know I was trying to tell that man last night, a fellow that was playing, a friend there was asking about Hugh Long's number when he was quoting his wife, was the same number that I wrote Dick. Oh, you love him, Hugh Long's numbers, and he's quoting. Is that what that number is? Something like the light of the silvery...
That's it. That's it. Yeah, I have to.
